title: Sum of the digits
prompt:
Write digit_sum(n) that returns the sum of the digits of the whole number n. For negative numbers ignore the minus sign.
Example: 4821 -> 15.
solution:
def digit_sum(n):
    n = abs(n)
    total = 0
    while n > 0:
        total += n % 10
        n //= 10
    return total
hints: How can you get the last digit of 4821? And how do you then 'remove' that digit to get 482?
The remainder after dividing by 10 is the last digit; dividing by 10 with // (whole-number division) drops it. When do you stop?
Plan: total = 0; while n is bigger than 0: add n % 10 to the total, then replace n with n // 10; return total. Take care of the minus sign first (abs).

edge_hints.zero: 0 has digit sum 0. A loop that runs 'while n > 0' never runs for 0, so make sure the starting total is returned.
edge_hints.negative: The minus sign is not a digit. Use abs(n) before you start.
